title: macrosolen krempfii

It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Macrosolen krempfii can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, research has identified the presence of iridoid glycosides, including ajugoside and secologanin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
